claim_text: Sinusoidal positional encoding uses sin(pos / 10000^{2i/d}), so nearby positions have a similar encoding.

spec.explain: Toy illustration of 1706.03762 sinusoidal encoding. Watch the wave number grow with i and compare it to seq to see when nearby positions stay similar and when they separate.

questions.q: Set i to 0 and watch wave. Do you expect positions one apart to look alike?
Set seq to 20 and watch cycles at i equal to 4.
questions.why: regime where wavelength equals sequence length

questions.q: Set i to 8 and watch wave.
Set d to 128 and watch cycles.
questions.why: read how dimension changes the wavelength

widget.draw: function draw(ctx, state, t) { var w = state.w; var h = state.h; var seq = state.seq; var d = state.d; var ii = state.i; function fmt(v) { return Math.round(v * 100) / 100; } var denom = Math.pow(10000, 2 * ii / d); var wave = 2 * Math.PI * denom; var cycles = seq / wave; var iStar = d / 2 * Math.log(seq / (2 * Math.PI)) / Math.log(10000); var x0 = 50; var y0 = 30; var pw = w - 110; var ph = 190; function X(p) { return x0 + p / seq * pw; } function Y(v) { return y0 + (1 - v) / 2 * ph; } ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h); ctx.fillStyle = "#f6f3ec"; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h); ctx.strokeStyle = "#1d1a16"; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.strokeRect(x0, y0, pw, ph); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x0, Y(0)); ctx.lineTo(x0 + pw, Y(0)); ctx.strokeStyle = "#b8ad9c"; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.stroke(); ctx.strokeStyle = "#1f4b99"; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.beginPath(); var n = 120; var k = 0; var pos = 0; var val = 0; for (k = 0; k <= n; k++) { pos = k / n * seq; val = Math.sin(pos / denom); if (k === 0) { ctx.moveTo(X(pos), Y(val)); } else { ctx.lineTo(X(pos), Y(val)); } } ctx.stroke(); ctx.fillStyle = "#1f4b99"; ctx.font = "13px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("wave = " + fmt(wave), x0, y0 + ph + 22); ctx.fillText("cycles = " + fmt(cycles), x0 + 190, y0 + ph + 22); ctx.fillText("pos", x0 + pw - 10, y0 + ph + 40); ctx.fillText("sin curve", x0 + 8, y0 + 14); var rx0 = 50; var rw = w - 110; var ry = 300; var imax = 16; function IX(v) { return rx0 + v / imax * rw; } ctx.strokeStyle = "#1d1a16"; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(rx0, ry); ctx.lineTo(rx0 + rw, ry); ctx.stroke(); var show = iStar; var clipped = 0; if (show > imax) { show = imax; clipped = 1; } if (show < 0) { show = 0; clipped = 1; } ctx.strokeStyle = "#c4512c"; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(IX(show), ry - 10); ctx.lineTo(IX(show), ry + 10); ctx.stroke(); ctx.fillStyle = "#c4512c"; ctx.font = "12px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("wavelength equals seq = " + fmt(show), IX(show) - 90, ry - 16); if (clipped === 1) { ctx.fillText("clipped", IX(show) - 90, ry + 28); } ctx.fillStyle = "#1f4b99"; ctx.fillRect(IX(ii) - 4, ry - 4, 8, 8); ctx.font = "12px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("current i = " + fmt(ii), IX(ii) - 30, ry + 44); }
